C0789.title: Chinese High-Tech Firm Hit by Suspected U.S. Intelligence Cyberattack Targeting Trade Secrets
C0789.summary: Starting in May 2023, a major Chinese smart energy and digital information enterprise was subjected to a cyberattack suspected to be carried out by a U.S. intelligence agency. The attackers exploited a Microsoft Exchange vulnerability to breach the company's email server, implant a backdoor, and continuously exfiltrate email data.
